cleaning_rules: keep only exercises present in the exercise table
correct is the published first-attempt column; nothing is recomputed
order by learner, then time_done (µs), then problem_number, then file order
one answer is one order: order_id is per row (D57)
review_mode answers are kept; topic_mode and suggested are metadata only
live is metadata, not a filter

split.scheme: k-fold by learner, with a validation split of each training fold

reading.rule: asl graf uchtasidan ham yuqori va har uch farqning 95 % CI si nolni kesib o‘tmasa — qo‘llab-quvvatlandi (D61)
reading.scope: natija shu graf uchun o‘qiladi — platformaning 2015-yil yanvardagi bilim xaritasi, bitta birlashtirilgan sikl va prerekvizitsiz mashqlar bilan (D61)
reading.limitation: cheklov: Junyi platformasi mashqni uning prerekvizitlari o‘zlashtirilgach tavsiya qiladi (suggested), shuning uchun ta’sirning bir qismi grafning o‘zidan emas, platformaning shu graf bo‘yicha yo‘naltirishidan kelishi mumkin (D62a)
reading.holm_family: H3: uch kontrast, har k uchun alohida oila (D62a)
